passage.quote:
Thread groups and scopes describe who can cooperate. A cooperative thread array
(CTA) is a group of threads that can use shared memory and synchronization;
CTAs launched together form a grid. A scope specifies which participants an
operation includes. The thread-group description explains these relationships,
including groups of CTAs called clusters and cooperation across a GPU.

summary: Identify each thread within its device, grid, cluster and cooperative thread array.
Define which participants each scope includes and require mutual inclusion where cross-thread rules need it.
remaining: Thread identities, group comparisons and CTA, cluster, GPU and system scope inclusion are implemented. Host CPU thread execution and physical register or launch mappings are outside this representation.

from.quote:
The model identifies each thread by its device, grid, cluster, CTA, and position
within the CTA. This arrangement is called the thread topology. Two threads must
have different complete identities, even if their position numbers within their
own CTAs are equal. CTA identifiers are names within this hierarchy, not raw
hardware register values.

passage.quote:
structure ThreadLocation where
  device : Nat
  grid : Nat
  cluster : Nat
  cta : Nat
  thread : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

from.quote:
A synchronization operation specifies which participants it can coordinate with.
This set of participants is its scope:

passage.quote:
def Scope.includes (scope : Scope) (issuer participant : ThreadLocation) : Bool :=
  match scope with
  | .cta => issuer.sameCTA participant
  | .cluster => issuer.sameCluster participant
  | .gpu => issuer.device == participant.device
  | .sys => true

from.quote:
| Scope | Included participants in this model |
| --- | --- |
| CTA | Threads in the same CTA |
| Cluster | Threads in the same cluster |
| GPU | Threads on the same GPU, including other grids |
| System | All represented GPU threads belonging to the host program |

passage.quote:
def Scope.includes (scope : Scope) (issuer participant : ThreadLocation) : Bool :=
  match scope with
  | .cta => issuer.sameCTA participant
  | .cluster => issuer.sameCluster participant
  | .gpu => issuer.device == participant.device
  | .sys => true
